Quotes are verbatim (checked by imb.py verify-labels against extracts/_staged_2026-09-27/raw, whitespace and case ignored). Prices are as spoken ('65.4' = 65,400). Every number here is SOURCED to the quote; tolerances and lookbacks are OURS and live in imb.py.
